policyholder_name.description: The business that wants to be insured, with its legal form; never the insurer or the broker

policyholder_tax_number.description: The policyholder's tax number, as printed

activity_code.description: The policyholder's main activity code (TEÁOR, NACE), digits as printed

contact_name.description: The person named as the contact

cover_start.description: The day cover should start, ISO YYYY-MM-DD

payment_frequency.description: How often the premium is to be paid, as printed

chosen_deductible.description: The deductible the policyholder chooses, plain decimal STRING, dot separator

bi_deductible_days.description: The business interruption's waiting period in days or working days, as printed

accounting_method.description: What the business interruption sum insured is counted from, as printed

interruption_sum_insured.description: The business interruption sum insured, plain decimal STRING, dot separator

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the form's amounts (Ft = HUF)

rental_income_cover.description: Whether the loss of rental income is to be covered, as printed

requested_covers.description: Every cover the form marks as wanted, in the order printed

sites.description: Every site the form lists, in the order printed

site_no.description: The site's number or mark on the form
